rv.q: Its magic has been, if anything, enhanced; its gift for subliminal seduction magnified.
"Metamorphoses," indeed, provides a nice package of simple pleasures that are increasingly hard to find, together or separately, on or Off Broadway...

aw.sub: Won Best Direction of a Play

cn.t: Zimmerman's water-staged adaptation of Ovid's tales enchants with dreamlike imagery and resonant themes of love and loss, making a successful transition from Off Broadway to the Circle in the Square.

vs.sum: Broadway's only thrust-stage theater offers an unmatched intimate experience — no seat is more than a few rows from the action. Sightlines are excellent from every angle, though some seats face actors' backs during certain scenes.

acc.note: Elevator accessible through adjoining building. Loop technology and neck induction systems available.
